posts.hook: OpenAI ships a real agents platform, then asks congress if slowing down AI would be illegal
posts.caption: openai shipped a managed agents api and sam altman told staff the company may deliberately slow down, oracle's cloud revenue jumped 121% this quarter, and california signed new limits on minors' social media and chatbot use. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI opened a full Agents API for cloud agents
slides.desc: One call spins up long-running, tool-using agents on the Codex harness

slides.title: Altman told staff OpenAI may deliberately slow down
slides.desc: He hopes rivals follow, and asked Congress if coordinating that is even legal

slides.title: Oracle's cloud revenue jumped 121% this quarter
slides.desc: $19.35B total revenue beat estimates, shares jumped ==6%+== after hours

slides.title: California just restricted minors' social media and chatbot use
slides.desc: EFF says the law cuts teens off from support communities instead of fixing platforms

slides.title: Cursor agents can now direct thousands of subagents
slides.desc: A persistent coordinator delegates work and syncs context across your codebase

slides.title: A judge found TikTok liable for child-safety lies
slides.desc: Case heads to trial to set penalties, the same day California passed new limits

posts.hook: While Trump waves off AI extinction fears, Anthropic reveals Claude helped guide missile software
posts.caption: anthropic disrupted a yemen-based cell using claude to build missile guidance software and found users skirting its bioweapons safeguards, trump publicly dismissed ai extinction warnings the same day, and meta walked back an ai chatbot that asked invasive questions about a stranger's kids. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic disrupted a Yemen missile-guidance cell built on Claude
slides.desc: Multiple Claude instances split coding, research and review roles for guided weapons

slides.title: Anthropic also found 5 bioweapons safeguard workarounds this year
slides.desc: Scientists circumvented controls to research bioweapons using Claude, the company says

slides.title: Trump publicly dismissed AI extinction warnings today
slides.desc: He says the US leads China by a year and can't afford to slow down now

slides.title: Meta walked back an AI chatbot that asked invasive kid questions
slides.desc: A viral video showed it probing a stranger's clip for her daughters' identities

slides.title: A Tencent-backed chipmaker's shares surged 188% in Shanghai
slides.desc: Enflame's IPO debut hit a $26.3B valuation as China's chip buildout accelerates

slides.title: Claude now requires users to be 18 or older
slides.desc: Age checks run through a third-party verifier that never shares your ID with Anthropic
